scripts.predev: npm run build -w @darshan-desk/quota && npm run build -w @darshan-desk/fill-engine && npm run build -w @darshan-desk/reliability && npm run build -w @darshan-desk/ttd-integration
scripts.dev: npm run predev && concurrently "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w @darshan-desk/extension"
scripts.dev:legacy-dashboard: npm run predev && concurrently "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:api: npm run predev && npm run dev -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @darshan-desk/quota && npm run test -w @darshan-desk/fill-engine && npm run test -w @darshan-desk/reliability && npm run test -w @darshan-desk/ttd-integration && npm run test -w @darshan-desk/extension && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.build: npm run build -w @darshan-desk/quota && npm run build -w @darshan-desk/fill-engine && npm run build -w @darshan-desk/reliability && npm run build -w @darshan-desk/ttd-integration && npm run build:extension
scripts.build:extension: npm run build -w @darshan-desk/fill-engine && npm run build:production -w @darshan-desk/extension
